name: Circles to the Max
subtitle: Turn photos into circle art
description:
Reveal your photos one circle at a time. Touch and drag across the canvas to divide large circles into smaller details, then adjust the shape of new circles with the slider.

Choose a photo or start with a sample image. Watch an automatic reveal, pause it to add your own touches, reset the canvas, and share your artwork as an image.

Set your preferred appearance and animation timing. Photos are processed on your device, with no account or subscription. Artwork is temporary until you share it; returning home resets the canvas.
whats_new: New home and settings screens, updated photo handling, and fixes for circle colors, animation, sharing and current iOS builds.
review_notes: No sign-in or paid unlock. Open Canvas to try a bundled sample or choose a photo with the system photo picker. Touch or drag to subdivide circles. Use the slider for the shape of new circles, Play/Pause for automated detail, Reset to begin again and Share to export. Home requests confirmation before clearing the canvas. Settings controls real animation timing and appearance. No server is required.
data_handling: Selected photos and rendered canvas remain on device and in memory.
System sharing exports an image only when chosen by the user.
No developer backend, account, advertising, analytics, IAP or cloud sync.
UserDefaults stores appearance and animation settings.

age_rating_source_review.samples: One original generated floral still-life image; no legacy sample JPGs are bundled.
age_rating_source_review.note: Source findings inform the actual Apple questionnaire; no final rating attestation by source agent.

content_rights_limit: Build 4 replaces the eight legacy sample JPGs with one newly generated still-life image. Historical sample authorship remains undocumented, but those files are excluded from this build.
validation_limit: Signed archive/headless checks are separate from required native workflows, screenshots and upload.
